name: mark_subtask_as_incomplete
description: Reopen one existing subtask of a Sunsama task that is currently marked complete, identified by its parent task id and subtask id. WRITE - this changes state the user and their teammates see. Use it only when the user explicitly said that specific subtask is not done after all; do not use it to reopen the parent task, to reopen several subtasks inferred from a general remark such as 'undo that', or for tasks in any other app. It cannot mark a subtask complete (use mark_subtask_as_completed).

taskId.description: The ID of the parent task
